query:
SELECT
                    q.id,
                    q.span_start,
                    q.span_end,
                    q.highlight_start,
                    q.highlight_end,
                    q.notes,
                    d.id         AS definition_id,
                    d.definition AS definition_text,
                    w.slug       AS word_slug,
                    w.lemma      AS word_lemma,
                    w.word       AS word,
                    q.created_at,
                    q.updated_at
                FROM quotation q
                JOIN definitions d ON d.id = q.definition
                JOIN words w       ON w.id = d.word
                WHERE q.translation = $1
                ORDER BY q.span_start ASC
                LIMIT $2
                OFFSET $3
